## User Story

**As a** developer  
**I want** a Pydantic-based tool framework  
**So that** tools register once and export JSON schemas for any LLM provider

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `stem/tools/base.py` with `Tool` base class
- [ ] `@tool` decorator converts function to Tool
- [ ] `ToolRegistry.register()` and `.get_schema()` methods
- [ ] JSON schema generation for Anthropic/OpenAI tool format

**Estimate:** 5
